hooks.command:
if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/VERSION" ]; then exit 0; fi
INPUT=$(cat)
V=$(awk 'NF{print $NF; exit}' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/VERSION" 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$V" ] || V=dev
if command -v solana >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  RPC=$(solana config get json_rpc_url 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}' | sed -E 's#^([a-z]+://[^/?]+).*#\1#')
  WALLET=$(solana address 2>/dev/null) || WALLET='none configured'
  CTX="Solana CLI: RPC ${RPC:-unknown}, wallet ${WALLET:-none configured}."
else
  CTX='Solana CLI not found on PATH.'
fi
case $INPUT in *'"startup"'*) ;; *) printf '%s\n' "$CTX"; exit 0 ;; esac
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s\n' "$CTX"; exit 0; }
BANNER=$(printf '%s\n' \
  '   _____ ____  __    ___    _   _____' \
  '  / ___// __ \/ /   /   |  / | / /   |' \
  '  \__ \/ / / / /   / /| | /  |/ / /| |' \
  ' ___/ / /_/ / /___/ ___ |/ /|  / ___ |' \
  '/____/\____/_____/_/  |_/_/ |_/_/  |_|' \
  '           ▄▀█ █   █▄▀ █ ▀█▀' \
  '           █▀█ █   █ █ █  █' \
  "     v$V — by @SuperteamBR 🇧🇷")
jq -n --arg b "$BANNER" --arg c "$CTX" '{systemMessage: $b, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: $c}}'

INPUT=$(cat)
CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$INPUT")
HIT=$(printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | grep -oE '\.ssh/|\.gnupg|\.aws/|\.config/solana/id\.json|\.npmrc|\.git-credentials|\.netrc|\.cargo/credentials|\.docker/config\.json|\.config/gh/hosts|\.kube/config|\.pypirc|\.gem/credentials|gh auth token|--show-token|Application[\\ ]+Support/Google/Chrome|Application[\\ ]+Support/BraveSoftware|Application[\\ ]+Support/Microsoft[\\ ]+Edge|Application[\\ ]+Support/Firefox|Application[\\ ]+Support/Chromium|Application[\\ ]+Support/Vivaldi|Application[\\ ]+Support/Arc|Application[\\ ]+Support/com\.operasoftware|\.config/google-chrome|\.config/BraveSoftware|\.config/microsoft-edge|\.mozilla/firefox|\.config/chromium|\.config/vivaldi|\.config/opera|AppData/Local/Google/Chrome|AppData/Local/BraveSoftware|AppData/Local/Microsoft/Edge|AppData/Roaming/Mozilla/Firefox|AppData/Local/Chromium|AppData/Local/Vivaldi|AppData/Roaming/Opera[\\ ]+Software|Local[\\ ]+Extension[\\ ]+Settings|moz-extension' | head -n 1)
[ -n "$HIT" ] || exit 0
echo "🛑 Blocked: reading private keys, wallet vaults or credentials is not allowed ($HIT). Use \`solana address\` for the pubkey; ask the user to run anything that needs the secret." >&2
exit 2

INPUT=$(cat)
case $INPUT in *solana*|*anchor*|*spl-token*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null) || CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | sed -nE 's/.*"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(([^"\\]|\\.)*)".*/\1/p')
RE='(^|[;&|(]|\$\()[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]]+)*([^[:space:];&|()]*/)?((solana|anchor) program (deploy|write-buffer|upgrade|extend|migrate|close|set-upgrade-authority|set-buffer-authority)|solana program-v4 (deploy|retract|transfer-authority|finalize)|anchor (deploy|upgrade)|solana (transfer|withdraw-stake|withdraw-from-vote-account|withdraw-from-nonce-account)|spl-token (transfer|burn|close|authorize))([[:space:]][^;&|]*)?([;&|)]|$)'
SEG=$(printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | grep -oE "$RE")
[ -n "$SEG" ] || exit 0
if printf '%s\n' "$SEG" | grep -qE -e '--final|--bypass-warning|program-v4 finalize|spl-token authorize[^;&|]*--disable'; then
  echo "🛑 Blocked: irreversible on-chain action (--final, program close --bypass-warning, program-v4 finalize or authorize --disable). If the user wants it, they run it themselves outside Claude." >&2
  exit 2
fi
set -f
CL= SRC='command flag' prev=
for w in $SEG; do
  case $prev in --url|-u|--provider.cluster) CL=$w ;; esac
  case $w in --url=*|--provider.cluster=*) CL=${w#*=} ;; -u?*) CL=${w#-u} ;; esac
  prev=$w
done
if [ -z "$CL" ]; then
  case $SEG in
    *anchor*) SRC=Anchor.toml; CL=$(awk -F'"' '/^[[:space:]]*cluster[[:space:]]*=/{print $2; exit}' Anchor.toml 2>/dev/null) ;;
    *) SRC='solana config'; CL=$(solana config get json_rpc_url 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}') ;;
  esac
fi
CL=$(printf '%s' "${CL#=}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed -E 's#^([a-z]+://[^/?]+).*#\1#' | tr -cd 'a-z0-9:/._-')
case $CL in
  m|*mainnet*) R="MAINNET (from $SRC): spends real SOL or changes a live program. Approve only if the user asked for mainnet." ;;
  d|*devnet*) R="On-chain write to devnet (from $SRC)." ;;
  t|*testnet*) R="On-chain write to testnet (from $SRC)." ;;
  l|localnet|*localhost*|*127.0.0.1*) R="On-chain write to localnet (from $SRC)." ;;
  '') R='On-chain write to an unknown cluster (no --url, Anchor.toml or solana config found). Check the target before approving.' ;;
  *) R="On-chain write to $CL (from $SRC). Check the cluster before approving." ;;
esac
printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}\n' "$R"
